title: I Left the Sticky on the Break-Room Air-Fryer That Only Burned My Fries

parts.text: I loaded the air-fryer at 12:11 p.m. and only my fries sat through a nine-minute scorch. Tess from sales ran a batch two minutes later and it dinged golden at four. I was twenty-seven, analyst, standing in a kitchen that made me look like I owned the wait. I opened the drawer. Mine was the dark basket she never rotated; Tess's side had the liner she swapped since June. I left a sticky: ROTATE FOR EVERYONE, NOT THE FAVORITE. Tess laughed, then her next batch sulked because I had actually run the clean she postponed. Facilities laminated my sticky. Tess rotate-dates the drawer. The fryer finally knows more than one name.

social.video_title: The air-fryer had a favorite sales basket — Part 1/1
social.description: Nine-minute scorches, four-minute gold for sales, a June liner. The sticky got laminated. Has an appliance ever skipped only you?
